description: E2d4: decisions on the reference audit proposals in docs/reference_audit_proposals.json. A human decision (checked_by human) is accepted (apply the proposed text), rejected (keep the reference) or edited (apply the reviewer's own text for the same span); it names its reviewer by a pseudonymous id (rv_ and 8 lower-case letters or digits, never a real name) and the date. Several reviewers may decide one proposal, one decision each (decision_id decision:<proposal_id>:<reviewer>); a proposal applies when at least min_reviewers reviewers decided it and all agree (min_reviewers is 1 for now), and every applied outcome records its reviewer_count. A rule decision (checked_by rule, E2d4b, schema v2) resolves a proposal that a maintainer-approved reference rule makes exactly on the page text (rule space_before_punctuation.v1, decision record planning/decisions/2026-11-07-space-before-punctuation-rule.md); its id is rule:<rule>:<proposal_id>, it names no reviewer and is never counted as human review. A proposal decided by a human takes no rule decision. An agent never writes a human decision here.
